judge.rationale: The candidate implementation is functionally identical to the reference, accurately accumulating token usage across tool rounds via an `accumulateUsage` helper while handling `undefined` rounds cleanly. It satisfies every acceptance criterion, including keeping `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` unedited, testing multi-round and partial-reporting turns, and updating `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`. To make the hook signature unambiguous as requested by the ticket, the candidate both renamed the parameter to `totalUsage` (matching the reference) and introduced a backwards-compatible `TotalUsageMetadata` type alias in `src/types/ai.ts`. Minor differences from the reference include placing `accumulateUsage` in `orchestratorHelpers.ts` instead of locally in `chatOrchestrator.ts`, adding tests in a separate acceptance test file rather than `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and omitting the doc updates in `CLAUDE.md` and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`.
